description: Adjudicates D4 of the conjugation-doubling dictionary: the tau identification must carry the 2-strand CHANNEL transpose to conjugation; the 5-letter partition transpose is excluded (isotype std->std(x)sign vs conjugation isotype-preserving, chi_std real). Exact geometry: bar/transpose = the two reflection axes of the fibre circle (fixed pts q=+-1 classical / q=+-i democratic); at q=+-i the Hecke relation degenerates to (sigma-+i)^2 — channels merge at spec(J). Derives no clause; nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact (sympy; S5 characters over all 7 classes + circle geometry + degenerate Hecke relation)

assertions.name: partition_transpose_excluded_isotype_mismatch
assertions.detail: chi_std real over all 7 classes => conjugation preserves the isotype (H^{0,1}~std); partition transpose sends std->(2,1,1,1)=std(x)sign with chi((12)) = 2 vs -2 — isotype-CHANGING, so it cannot be conjugation. EXCLUDED (scope-(a))

assertions.name: channel_transpose_S5_neutral_survives
assertions.detail: the channel transpose phi: q -> -q^{-1} acts on the loop-parameter/channel index only — every S5 character value is q-independent hence phi-invariant: isotype-PRESERVING like conjugation. The unique surviving candidate of the two

assertions.name: fibre_circle_two_reflections
assertions.detail: on |q|=1: bar = reflection across R (theta->-theta; fixed q=+-1, the classical points, channels FIXED) and transpose = reflection across iR (theta->pi-theta; fixed q=+-i, the democratic points, channels SWAPPED); composition = antipode q->-q — the two involutions are the two reflection axes of the fibre circle

assertions.name: channels_merge_exactly_at_specJ
assertions.detail: at q=+-i the Hecke relation becomes (sigma -+ i)^2 = 0 — the channel pair MERGES with common eigenvalue +-i; and {+i,-i} = spec(J), the complex-structure eigenvalues whose eigenspaces are H^{1,0}/H^{0,1} and whose swap IS conjugation: the channel doubling collapses exactly at the eigenvalues of the operator whose doubling it is conjectured to match

result.circle_geometry: bar = reflection across R (q=+-1 classical); transpose = reflection across iR (q=+-i democratic); composition = antipode
result.specJ_coincidence: Hecke relation degenerates to (sigma-+i)^2 at q=+-i = spec(J)
result.verdict: D4 ADJUDICATED (necessary conditions; scope-(a); derives no clause; no fit; nothing wired): the tau identification must carry the 2-STRAND CHANNEL transpose (q -> -q^{-1}) to complex conjugation on H^1(Bring). The 5-letter PARTITION transpose is EXCLUDED — it changes the S5 isotype (std -> std(x)sign; chi((12)): 2 vs -2) while conjugation preserves it (chi_std real over all 7 classes, H^{0,1}~std); the channel transpose is S5-neutral and survives. Exact geometry: on the fibre circle bar and transpose are the two reflection axes (fixed points q=+-1 classical / q=+-i democratic; composition = antipode), and at q=+-i the Hecke relation degenerates to (sigma-+i)^2 — the channels merge exactly at spec(J) = {+-i}, the complex-structure eigenvalues whose eigenspace swap IS conjugation. The full tau-functor derivation (the correspondence wall) remains open; its target is now UNIQUE. NO tier change.
